lines.en: Dad, school is so far. It's a ten-minute walk!
Ten minutes? When I was your age...
Every morning, I would wake up before the rooster, tie my books with string, and start walking.
Not ten minutes. Hours. Hill after hill, with no shoes.
Then came the Blue Nile. I would hold my books over my head. There was always a hungry crocodile. I never stopped.
Next, the Chebera Churchura jungle. Elephants used to block the path, so I would walk right under them.
Then I would climb the Simien mountains. The geladas just used to watch me, without helping.
And then, the volcano. Erta Ale. I would jump from rock to rock over the lava. My feet were always on fire.
Finally, wet and smoking, I would reach school. And every day, my teacher would say...
